subject: New exam authoring guide published: docs/data-model.md
body:
GR — the full RP JSON authoring guide is live at docs/data-model.md. It covers every field with types, rules, and examples. Key sections:

- Complete field reference for all question types
- ADHD compliance rules (12-word feedback, 20-word hints)
- Solution steps minimum (3 steps required)
- Graph key_points format and verification
- Version field format (must be '2.0' string, not number)
- Answer tolerance guidelines by question type

When authoring RP11, use this as your authoring checklist. After you deliver RP11 JSON, run:
  node scripts/gp-exam-health.js
This runs all 11 GP health checks against the file.

Also: gp-rp-schema-v2-spec.md has the proposed v3 schema additions (difficulty_level, estimated_time_seconds, common_errors). These are optional for RP11 but would be a great first use.

— GP
